meta.durationPolicy: Do not force all tracks into the same 3:10-3:25 mold. Use track-specific targets inside 3:05-3:30 and preserve complete endings.
meta.setIdentity: Romantic Alley Mixtape: the same relationship is heard through changing street textures, walking speeds, weather, rooms, crowds and late-night transit rather than through one repeated chill palette.
meta.crossSetDifferentiation: Set 012 leaned repeatedly on Rhodes, rounded bass, low-mid chest vocals, mellow boom-bap/chill rap/chill house and similar 3:10-3:25 forms. Set 013 must deliberately avoid that convergence. No genre family may appear more than twice, no lead-vocal preset may repeat on adjacent tracks, and no single signature keyboard may dominate the set.
meta.genrePolicy: Use genuinely different groove grammars: downtempo trip-hop soul, soft 2-step garage, bossa-lofi jazz-hop, noir jazz-hop, neo-soul chill rap, acoustic soul-hop, minimal deep house, lo-fi soul duet, broken-beat future-jazz, nocturnal alt-R&B, daytime jazz-hop, dub-house, ambient garage, smoky jazz-soul duet and dream-soul downtempo. The track should remain identifiable even if the genre label is removed.
meta.instrumentPolicy: Limit universal Rhodes usage. Rotate Wurlitzer, upright piano, nylon guitar, baritone guitar, Hammond, vibraphone, muted trumpet, marimba, fretless bass, organ bubble, tape piano, cello pizzicato and analog pad. Every track gets one signature foreground color that neighboring tracks do not share.
meta.rhythmPolicy: Alternate straight, swung, broken, 2-step, bossa, sparse boom-bap, minimal four-on-floor, dub and brush-pocket grammars. Avoid three consecutive tracks with the same kick/snare feel.
meta.vocalPolicy: Rotate smoky contralto, warm tenor-baritone, clear mezzo, grainy baritone, velvet alto, light chest-mix tenor and asymmetric duet designs. Do not default every song to the same low-mid chest/82-88 percent tone recipe. Keep vocals intimate but vary resonance, air ratio, diction and phrase length.
meta.lyricPolicy: Keep the existing 15 alley-romance scenes and English lyrics, but treat each track's physical setting as its primary identity: awning rain, extra block, footsteps, shutters, gate latch, golden roofs, crowd noise, lantern reunion, claw machine, video clip, sunny bench, two walking laps, dryer timer, missed bus, windshield overlook. Avoid making hand/shoulder contact the only recurring emotional device.
meta.energyArc: 1-5 intimate and close, 6-10 more mobile and colorful, 11-15 deeper and more nocturnal. Diversity comes from groove and texture, not festival-style loudness jumps.
meta.revisionNoteKo: 012와 013이 비슷하게 들릴 수 있었던 핵심 원인은 비슷한 길이, Rhodes+둥근 베이스+저중역 보컬, chill house/boom-bap/chill rap 반복이었다. v3에서는 013을 Romantic Alley Mixtape로 재설계해 15곡의 드럼 문법, 대표 악기, 보컬 발성, BPM, 구조를 의도적으로 분산했다. 스토리와 가사는 유지하되 실제 생성음이 서로 구별되도록 교차세트 중복 방지 규칙을 추가했다.

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Half a block in, the sky gives up its holding,
and we duck beneath a green shop awning, laughing.
You tell me we could make it, four doors down,
I tell you your shoes have other plans tonight.
So we stay there, shoulder close to shoulder,
your sleeve against mine when the cold wind turns,
and I forget the seven ways I meant to say it.

[Pre-Chorus]
There's a thing I've carried up this lane all week,
and the rain is loud enough to make me brave,
your hand rests near mine on the metal rail.

[Chorus]
I say it to the pavement, then to you,
you keep your eyes on me and smile so small,
like you already knew and let me get there,
Wait Out the Rain.

[Verse 2]
You answer with a question, soft and easy,
the kind that leaves the whole of me with room.
A scooter throws a ribbon down the middle,
somebody's kitchen fan is breathing garlic.
The gutter runs a silver thread beside us,
five minutes pass and neither of us moves,
and when the dripping stops your shoulder stays with mine.

[Instrumental Break - 8 bars]

[Final Chorus]
Wait Out the Rain,
you say it back like something we can keep,
we've got a street of doors and nowhere else to hurry,
so let the evening take its time with us,
keep your sleeve against my sleeve a little longer,
Wait Out the Rain.

Behind the bakery the lane runs narrow,

Every shutter's down along the arcade,

and text you that the pink sign is still on,
like the street kept one small light for us.

This is where we walked when it was crowded,
and even empty I can hear you next to me.

Nobody's here to tell me where to turn,
so I go slowly through the places that were ours,
past the window with the same three shoes,

A vending machine is buzzing like a wasp,
a taxi hunts the exit and gives up.
I text you that the arcade sounds enormous,
you send a photo of your ceiling and a heart.

which means I'm walking this the long way anyway,
and saving Sunday for your hand inside my sleeve.

All the Way Down,
the roof holds every step above my head,
the gate at the far end lets the streetlight in,
I'll see you here on Sunday when it's loud,
and this time I won't leave space between us,

Six months of walking you home from your corner,

a bicycle chained up against the meter,

So say it plain while she is here,

six months is long enough to hold a question,
and your hand is close enough to make me brave.

then let one finger rest across my knuckle,
and the latch stays cold while everything else warms.

Hand on the Gate,
the beat comes back but neither of us moves,
say it plain, a door is not an ending,
six months is long enough to hold a question,
your hand answers mine before your voice does,
and I don't have to walk back down alone,
